text:
maria: Quick sync — Mosaic and FinanceX asked for a smaller mobile payload option for chat. They want to keep roles + tool calling but send fewer tokens. Can we prioritize a compact/messages-condense mode?

 tom: Which of their asks are blocking launches?

 maria: Mosaic: cost/latency on mobile; FinanceX: must guarantee system role enforcement (auditable). Both asked for a way to send "just the tail" or a short summary instead of the full message history.

 ashley: Proposal: add an optional condense mode on chat endpoint. Modes: full_messages (default), condensed (client provides short summaries/deltas + last user turn), prompt_fallback (server expands to prompt for older clients). SDKs provide helpers to condense/expand.

 ken: Big question: semantics for system role if clients send condensed history. We need deterministic reconstruction rules so clients can't drop a system message and escalate.

 maria: Acceptance criteria (must-have to ship beta):
 - API accepts condensed payload when ?condense=true
 - SDK helpers that produce canonical condensed entries
 - Telemetry: token delta recorded per request (raw vs expanded)
 - E2E tests that validate system role preservation and function-call parity
 - Audit log when server injects a system message back into expanded context

 ashley: Implementation sketch: parsing/proxy layer expands condensed entries into normal message array before runtime. No model changes. Example condensed payload we discussed: 
```json
{
  "model":"redwood-xxl",
  "condense": true,
  "messages_condensed":[
    {"type":"summary","origin":"client","summary":"omitted 7 msgs, last user: 'Any updates on pricing?'"},
    {"role":"user","content":"What's new in the enterprise pricing?"}
  ]
}
```
Keep it explicit: use metadata keys (type/origin) not new roles.

 ken: Agreed — do NOT invent a new role like "meta". If a summary exists, it must be tagged and the server must not treat it as a system/assistant utterance. Server-side expansion must: 1) attach pinned system if project config requires it, 2) record an audit entry if injection happens, 3) reject condensed payloads that try to spoof system role.

 tom: Effort estimate: parser + validation + audit logs = ~2 dev-weeks (ken). SDK helpers + docs = ~1.5 dev-weeks (ashley). Contract tests + telemetry = 3 days. Staged rollout + customer beta = 3–6 weeks.

 maria: Migration strategy: opt-in flag (condense=true) for beta customers. SDKs default to full_messages until we stabilize. After metrics show token savings with no regressions, promote to opt-out for new sessions.

 ashley: Docs and examples to include: how condense affects function calling, structured output, and safety. Show canonical expansion algorithm and validator snippet. Also provide an "expand" util in SDKs.

 ken: Also: enforcement rule — if condensed payload omits an explicit system message and the project has a pinned system, server injects it. If injection occurs, the response payload includes header: "system_injected": true and we write an audit event to the project audit log.

 maria: Roadmap timeline (tentative):
 - Week 1: spec + API PR
 - Week 2: SDK helpers + contract tests
 - Week 3: internal beta w/ Mosaic + FinanceX
 - Week 5: public opt-in beta
 - Week 10: enable for new sessions by default (roll forward based on metrics)

 dev-bot: Deploy preview created: /api/condense-parser — preview-42

 maria: Decision: proceed with optional condensed messages mode. Constraints: no new semantic roles, audit-log injection for system messages, require FinanceX legal signoff before GA. Owners: ken (parser+tests), ashley (SDKs+docs). :thumbsup:

 ken: Will pick up parser work and start contract tests tomorrow.

 ashley: I'll draft migration guide and SDK helpers this week.

 maria: I'll add initiative "condense-msgs" to roadmap board and open tracking ticket. End of thread.
